title: Victim Of The Rampage
paragraphs: “Drinking in a tavern while the sun is still up… huh.”
“I’m starting to forget why we even came to another world.”
Ren and Itsuki grumbled as they ate lunch. And to think they were so eager to drink last time…
“I don’t like crowds… but it’s going to get noisy, isn’t it?”
“We can’t avoid it, can we?”
“I know. After seeing that level of strength, it’s unavoidable.”
Ren agreed without complaint. From what I saw in the previous loop, he isn’t that unreasonable. Teaching him the proper strengthening methods is key.
“The filolial chicks will hatch tomorrow, right?”
Fiancée murmured as she looked at the eggs she had prepared. Incidentally, it seems that she and the big sister’s friend have already become conversation partners.
“Does Princess Melty like filolials?”
“Just call me Melty. Yes, I grew fond of them after traveling with them for so long.”
They seem to be making small talk.
“The assassins from the Three Heroes Church… probably won’t come, but shouldn’t we use our free time to level up?”
“That’s not a bad idea.”
It would be impressive if they could locate us when we’re moving around using portals. Still, we don’t know where assassins might be hiding, so we should remain cautious.
“Then how about we each go off and do our own thing near Zeltbull?”
“Shall I send you to the hunting grounds? It’d be a hassle if you got tangled up with some rough mercenaries.”
“Yeah, that would help. Since Naofumi can’t fight alone and we need to find that Sadina, we’ll leave him in charge of holding down the fort.”
“What are you talking about?”
Father returned after finishing his conversation with the tavern master.
“We were talking about taking some free time to level up.”
“Right. Since Naofumi needs to find that person and look after the others, we’re thinking of leaving him behind.”
“Well… I know he doesn’t have any offensive power, we figured that out two days ago.”
Father nodded with a complicated expression.
“We’ll fight in his place, right?”
The big sister’s friend spoke to her, but the big sister looked uneasy and frightened.
Hmm… So the big sister had a phase like this too. In the original timeline, she was so brave that the contrast is striking.
“I’ll help too. I know a bit of magic.”
Fiancée raised her hand.
“So, what’s the plan?”
“Hmm… To be honest, I am interested in fighting. But I also feel like I should be looking for Sadina, even though I’m not exactly a guardian for Raphtalia-chan and Rifana-chan.”
Father crossed his arms and looked at the big sister and her friend, pondering deeply.
“Of course, I’ll respect both of your wishes. But you’ll need to practice, not just listen to how the experience points and party system work.”
“Are there drinkers coming here during the day?”
“That’s the problem. Well, if it’s before sunset, practicing against weak monsters might be a good idea. Everyone knows the hunting grounds, right? Can you show them?”
Ren and Itsuki looked at me. They’re probably wondering if the monster habitats have changed.
“Well… for weaker monsters, there’s not much difference from the game era. The habitat maps should still be accurate.”
But weak monsters are just that—weak. Fighting until sunset and reaching around level 4 or 5 would be the best they could hope for. As practice, it’s not a bad idea.
“However, caution is necessary. Especially for Ren and Itsuki, don’t misunderstand the strengthening methods.”
“We understand.”

“Yes, we’ll be mindful not to cling to fixed ideas. We’ll buy the necessary enhancement items for our starting weapons with the money we received and then confirm things through practice in the hunting grounds.”
“Now, how should we split into groups…”
“I think Ren-san and I can go solo, right? There shouldn’t be a problem with weak monsters.”
“Yeah. I’ll stay as cautious as possible. We’ll wrap things up early when it’s time.”
“Then I guess I’ll be going with these girls? Or rather…”
Father turned his gaze toward the big sister and her friend. The big sister grasped her friend’s hand and trembled.
“You understand, right, Naofumi? You can’t separate those two.”
“What about Melty-san?”
Itsuki asked Fiancée.

Hmm… It’s not a bad idea for her to stay with Father as his guard, but like Éclair, raising her as part of the initial preparations also seems reasonable. Since we’ll be leaving for the Draukia mountain range tomorrow, it’s best to train at least one guard.
“Then I’ll take Fiancée ahead and do some Spartan-level training.”
“Eh? That’s already decided?”
“I’m not too fond of leveling up without proper preparation, though…”
Ah, right. I remember hearing that Fiancée had that kind of policy, which is why her level was so low. But we don’t have time to be leisurely about it.
“If that’s the case, we won’t get anywhere…”
“I-I’m sorry…”
Fiancée lowered her head apologetically. Then, she looked at me and gave a small nod. It seems she’s agreeing.
“I’ll also procure some powerful equipment while I’m at it.”
“I-I’m counting on you. Melty-chan, do your best with Motoyasu-kun.”
“Yes.”
Fiancée looked a little uneasy but accepted my invitation.
“Then we’ll meet up around sunset.”
“Understood.”
“Zeltoble doesn’t have scattered hunting grounds like Melromarc, so we’ll be together until a certain point.”
“There are many places along the coast outside the town.”
“The back alleys are dangerous, right? We’ll have to be careful.”
“Motoyasu is looping again, after all.”
It seems Father and the others were bracing themselves. But I won’t give up.
“Well then… let’s head out for a bit.”

And so, we each went off to hunt. Of course, I escorted them part of the way. After that, I took Fiancée and ran straight to a dangerous hunting ground deep in the mountains where strong monsters lurked.
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Hahaha! Weak! Too weak!”

I fought the same way as when I went hunting with Éclair. The enemies feel far weaker compared to the previous loop. It feels like I could easily reduce the surrounding area to scorched earth, but since environmental destruction is not my goal, I refrain. In the loop before the last one, Father and the rival’s acquaintances said this:
“Pointless slaughter of monsters should be avoided. One must have resolve in battle.”

I always face battle with resolve. I take care to act in a way that doesn’t disrupt the ecosystem too much. However, the more I think about it, the more I realize how much garbage exists in this world. Even monsters are better.
Hahahahahaha!
“Y-Yari no Yuusha-sama! Stop! Please, stop! Kyaaaaaaa!”
Fiancée is screaming about something, but I’m not listening. Since it was a hassle, I carried her halfway and charged through the mountain paths while taking down monsters.
“Take that! There!”
Monsters have their own territories, and the foolish ones who challenge me are dealt with accordingly.

My goal is world peace! To achieve that, I’ll move forward, even if I have to use you as stepping stones! With that attitude, I progressed through the hunting ground and raised Fiancée’s level to 38 by the end of the day.
“Ugh…”
Fiancée looked dizzy and nauseous.
If she’s getting dizzy at this level, she won’t be able to handle the ride of a Filolial, will she?
“Now then, what should I bring back as a souvenir for Father and the others?”

I don’t have a Filolial to carry the dismantled monsters to Father, and even if I prepare a cart, it’ll only be for today. …It can’t be helped. I’ll pack as much material as I can carry in a bag and hand over the rest as drops. The defeated monsters were absorbed into my spear.
“Ugh…”
Fiancée looked completely drained. She’s not a crimson swine, so she shouldn’t be so dazed.
…Or maybe she’s more like Éclair?
“Come on, Fiancée, we’re going.”
“Ugh… So this is… a hero’s battle…? To overcome the waves, we have to go this far…? Mother… the situation is more dire than I imagined…”
With that, Fiancée collapsed and lost consciousness. It can’t be helped. I carried Fiancée on my back and returned to Zeltoble through the portal.
Chapter 772 – Acting
We met up at the rendezvous point and returned to the inn.
“Ren, Itsuki, Father, how did it go?”
“Not bad. Thanks to practicing the enhancement method, I was able to go much further than what’s expected for an initial level.”
“Yes, using the enhancement method as instructed allowed me to fight slightly stronger monsters.”
“Yeah… but in my case, I’m still relying on Raphtalia and Rifana, so I’m not sure how effective it was.”
The sister and her friend nodded.
“Let’s do our best, Raphtalia.”
“B-but…”
It seems the sister’s friend is showing more motivation. Apparently, the sister was too scared of the monsters to do anything.
Strange. It’s hard to believe this is the same brave figure from the first world.
“Rifana seems to be recovering from her cold.”
“Yes.”
On the other hand, the sister’s friend did her best to support Father. The sister looked downcast. Father gave her a gentle smile.
“Being forced to fight with unfamiliar people is scary. Well, the goal is just to raise your level, so don’t worry about it.”
“U…uh…”
The sister gave Father a hesitant reply.
I wonder… is she really the same sister? I’m starting to feel uneasy.
“By the way, Motoyasu, Melty looks completely drained… is she okay?”
“There’s nothing wrong with her body. In fact, level-wise, she’s in perfect condition.”
She’s already on the verge of a class-up. I’d like to give her the special class-up that Father’s group taught us. But without Filo-tan or Yuki-chan, I can’t enhance her potential.
Maybe it just needs a little more time?
“…Where exactly did you go?”
“I’ll give you some of the materials and drop items as souvenirs. Since it’s not appropriate here, let’s do it in the room.”
I managed to gather some quality items this time.

Should I give them to Fiancée or the sisters? Since the last loop, I’ve learned that if I give Father and the others equipment beyond their current level and abilities, they won’t be able to move properly. I have to be careful.
“Ah… okay. Then… let’s head back to the inn. I’m a bit tired, and we should let Melty rest.”
“Understood!”

After returning to the inn, I took out the souvenirs from my spear and handed them to Father and the others. I was hoping to get some decent transitional equipment, but it seems they’re still not ready to handle them.
“Melty, are you okay?”
“Ugh…”
Fiancée shuddered.

Did she see something frightening? Should I take care of it for her? You are Filo-tan’s Fiancée. My goal is to make you acknowledge that I am worthy of taking Filo-tan from you. After the break, we had dinner, and Father waited at the tavern with the sisters and their friend until they grew sleepy, hoping to meet the sisters’ older sister. In the end, they couldn’t find her that night. I think the reason they failed was because Father cut the search short to take care of the sister, who was crying a lot that night. When we returned to the inn, Father hugged the sister tightly as she sobbed herself to sleep and looked at us.
“What should we do tomorrow?”
By the way, I’ve been teaching weapon enhancement methods daily, and both Ren and Itsuki are currently practicing them.
“The queen said that even if we can get close, we’ll need to head to the Dracia Mountains soon, or we won’t make it in time.”
“But we still haven’t found that person, Sadina…”
“Either way, wouldn’t it be better after we’ve become strong enough?”
“Yeah. According to Motoyasu, it’s not like they’re being tortured like Raphtalia and Rifana were. There’s no need to rush and save them, right?”
“Indeed, the sister’s older sister isn’t being tortured.”
In the previous world, she was on the brink of death, but that seemed to be due to psychological trauma, and this time, the situation is quite different.
“A week or two of delay shouldn’t be a problem. The queen is handling things on her end.”
“I know that, but…”
“Naofumi, it’s fine to be concerned about them, but we need to get stronger. Otherwise, we’ll die.”
“Yes, and it’s pointless if we can’t move forward while searching for Sadina. What if she misunderstands when she sees Raphtalia and Rifana and attacks us?”
“Ah… if she’s strong, that’s possible. I hadn’t considered that…”
Father gently patted the sister’s back and hummed a lullaby to comfort her. He really is good at taking care of others.
“Alright then. If we find the people we’re looking for tomorrow, we’ll depart.”
“Understood.”

Sister’s older sister, please be patient a little longer. I’ve protected the sister as promised. By the time they’re reunited, I’ll make sure she’s as strong as the sister from the first world. The next day. It seems that, under the queen’s orders and through the monster merchant, a few of the slaves from the sister’s village have been gathered. First, we headed to the monster merchant. Father entered the shop with a determined switch flipped on, refusing to lose.
“You know, Naofumi, you’re really good at doing business.”
“Isn’t it just about analyzing the situation so you don’t get taken advantage of? It’s a hassle.”
“Maybe I should learn from that? Unlike in the game, you can’t just rely on a system to haggle prices.”
“But isn’t the country providing support? Does it even matter?”
“There’s a limit to that support. Right now, what we’re using is the compensation from the Trash King’s punishment.”
“Hmm…”
Ren and Itsuki observed this and whispered to each other.
Are they talking about using Father as a reference? That’s a very good sign. But Ren and Itsuki trying to imitate Father… how laughable.
“Well, well, brave heroes. Thank you very much for coming to our humble shop. Yes, yes.”
“Ah, so? Were you able to get the slaves I requested?”
“Yes, yes. Fortunately, a colleague had just purchased them, so I was able to prepare them immediately. Yes, yes.”
“Bububu!”
Oh? Keel is here.
Are there two others as well? The slave trader presented them, starting with Keel as the representative.
Where have you been last time? Just like the time before, he’s been causing a ruckus next to the monster merchant.
“Are these the ones you’re looking for? Yes, yes.”
“Ah, yeah… So, how much?”
“We’ve already received payment from the kingdom for these slaves. Yes, yes.”
“Wait… Weren’t they confiscated?”
“There was some miscommunication, but for now, they’re being left as they are. Yes, yes.”
“I see…”
Father approaches Keel. Ah, yes, that’s right. Ren and Itsuki are here, so this is perfect timing.
“Father, you should also ask for some ink used for slave registration while you’re at it. You can use that material to create weapons that enhance the slaves’ abilities and growth corrections.”
“Huh? Well… I suppose so.”
While maintaining the act, he glanced toward Ren and Itsuki as if seeking confirmation.
“Should we get the weapons as materials, just in case…?”
“Are you planning to use slaves?”
“It depends on the situation.”
Ren and Itsuki responded. Keel and the other slaves were reacting differently, as if waiting for their execution. Of course, Keel was showing resistance.
“Hmm… So this is Keel.”
“Bububububu!”
Same lines as always, huh? Trash has already been disposed of, and the release of the slaves from Éclair’s domain has been declared. I suppose they haven’t been informed yet.
“He seems to have a bit of a temperament. Are you sure about this? Yes, yes.”
“Ah… well.”
At that moment, the sister’s friend peeked out from behind Father.
“Keel-kun.”
“Bububuhi!?”

Oh? In the previous world, he showed hostility, but now he looks surprised and calms down upon seeing the sister and her friend. I suppose there’s a sense of security in seeing someone from the same hometown.
“It’s okay, calm down. You’ll be free soon!”
“Buh?”
Keel glanced back and forth between Father and the sisters.
“By the way, Naofumi-sama.”
“W-what?”
“Earlier… that thing about becoming stronger by becoming a slave, is that true?”
“Apparently, yes.”
The sister’s friend put a finger to her lips and started thinking.
“If it makes us stronger, should we take advantage of that?”
“W-well…”

Father averted his eyes and looked at the monster merchant. He was trying not to show any weakness, knowing that showing vulnerability here would get him taken advantage of. Sensing that, the sister’s friend grabbed Father’s hand, pretended to be pulled forward, and stood in front of him.
“‘Kyaa! You lied to us! You liar!’”
“Uwaah! —Heh, it’s your fault for getting fooled!”
Father played along with the sister’s friend’s performance and observed the monster merchant’s reaction. As for Keel, he was leaning forward, protesting the situation.
Chapter 773 – Chick
“From now on, you all will go to the castle, where a more complex and troublesome crest will be engraved on you than the slave crests used here. You will act as our slaves. Prepare yourselves!”
Gong! It seems one of the monster merchant’s subordinates has struck a gong-like instrument. The two besides Keel are trembling.
“Is that really true?”
“Naofumi-san is just acting. He mentioned it yesterday, remember? If you show weakness to merchants, they’ll take you lightly and might just take your money.”
“I see… So, Rifana is improvising. She’s really something.”
“We should also play along and smile like villains. It’s for the sake of those we need to protect.”
“Even if it’s an act, making all the heroes look like villains… there’s no hope left.”

Ren and Itsuki whispered to each other and then started grinning as if playing along. Of course, I’ve been smiling from the beginning. Fiancée, however, seems either a bit exasperated or still tired from yesterday. She’s just spacing out.
“‘Let go! No! Help me! Fugh—’”
The sister’s friend is quite good at acting. She’s pretending to struggle, with Father’s hand covering her mouth as if restraining her.
“As expected of the great heroes! We are truly in awe of your abilities!”
The monster merchant is ecstatic.
I suppose he realizes that this is just an act to some extent?
“Bubububuuu!”
Keel is struggling as if about to lunge at Father. Hahaha, that’s impossible for you right now.
“Well then, these slaves will be used in the castle. Take them away.”
“Understood. Yes, yes!”
“Now, I’ll be using you plenty from now on. Do your best to survive.”
“Bu!”
“U-uh…”
The sister seems to be left out of the loop.
To add some flair, should I act like I captured her? I stood behind her, smiling as if to block any chance of escape.
“Awwa…”
The sister’s forced smile crumbled, and she collapsed in fear. And so, the slaves were loaded onto a caged wagon and rattled away toward the castle.
“We look forward to your continued patronage. Yes, yes!”
The monster merchant bowed and left the castle grounds.
“Ah, see you then.”
Father and I waved as the merchant and his men left.
“Phew…”
Father slumped as if exhausted.
“Okay, it’s fine now. You can stop acting. And Motoyasu-kun, you scared Raphtalia-chan too much.”
“That was most disrespectful.”

Since the sister couldn’t walk after collapsing, she was put into the cage along with Keel and taken away. Her friend, meanwhile, was cursing Father and the others as part of her performance. She was giving them a resentful glare. It was a truly convincing act.
“How did it go?”
“It was a bit over the top. I’ll unlock the cage now.”
With a clank, the cage was unlocked, and the sister and the others were released. Immediately after, Keel tried to lunge at Father but was stopped by the sister’s friend.
“Keel-kun, calm down. These people aren’t bad.”
“Bububububu!”
“It was just an act. You see, Keel-kun, we had to pretend to be bad people there, or they wouldn’t have gathered the villagers.”
“Bu?”

“We haven’t introduced ourselves yet, have we? My name is Iwatani Naofumi, the Shield Hero summoned to this world. Over there is Amaki Ren, the Sword Hero, and Kawasumi Itsuki, the Bow Hero. And the one who taught us that we need to help everyone quickly is Kitamura Motoyasu, the Spear Hero. The girl with us is Melty-chan.”
Father introduced himself to Keel with a gentle tone and expression.
“Yes, that’s right. The heroes saved us!”
The sister’s friend proudly puffed out her chest as she spoke to Keel. Keel averted his gaze and took a few steps back. The other slaves were also looking on, still half in doubt.
“Bububuhi?”
“The special slave crest? That was a lie.”
“Well, yeah. There’s no way we’d do something like that to Rifana-chan and the others. Even if it means their abilities would improve.”
“I… I wouldn’t mind if Naofumi-sama became my master…”
The sister’s friend clasped her hands together, looking slightly embarrassed as she spoke.
What does that mean? Could it be that she has a desire to become a slave?
“R-Rifana-chan?”
Father had a surprised expression. Keel and the other rescued slaves looked on with confusion. To them, Father spoke gently, as if trying to reason with them.
“You don’t have to believe us yet. Trust isn’t something that can be forced… but I’d prefer if you’d come with us.”
Father sighed.
“We’ll convince Keel-kun and the others, so Naofumi-sama, please don’t worry.”
“Really?”
At that moment, a shadow appeared next to Fiancée and whispered something.
“Heroes… a message from Mother. It’s time to depart.”
“I see. Got it. Raphtalia-chan, Rifana-chan, can I ask you to explain the situation while we’re on our way?”
“Yes! Leave it to me!”
“Y-yes…”The sister and her friend began explaining things to Keel and the others.
The slaves were left dumbfounded. Well, either way, if they don’t agree, they won’t be able to use the portal to travel.

“For now, everyone! Listen. The heroes saved us… and they’re going to help rebuild the village. But in the meantime, I want to become stronger alongside the heroes so that everything isn’t taken away from us again by slave hunters.”
“Bubu…”
Keel let out a bitter groan.

“Of course, I know some of you might not want to fight, and the heroes said they won’t force anyone. But at the very least, raising your level a bit wouldn’t hurt. So, won’t you come with the heroes for a little while?”
“Hero, since it was expected that new companions would be joining, I placed an order with the weapon shop yesterday for beginner equipment.”
Fiancée, being considerate, handed out the weapons that had been delivered to the slaves. Oh, as expected of Filo-tan’s Fiancée. The slaves looked wide-eyed at the weapons they were handed.
“We haven’t registered the slave crest or master yet, right?”
“Shouldn’t we release it?”
When Father said this, the sister’s friend nodded.
“That’s up to them as well. Right, Raphtalia-chan?”
“We… can return to the village, right?”
The sister asked for confirmation.
“Of course. But since rebuilding… or rather, gathering people will take some time, in the meantime, you’ll either stay at the castle… with that Éclair person, right? Or with us.”
Father answered the sister’s friend’s question.
“See? Isn’t it better than doing nothing?”
“Bubu…”
“Well… if Rifana-chan says so…”
“We just reunited, and now we have to part again…”

With that, it seemed that Keel and the other slaves had accepted the sister’s friend’s proposal. Well, Éclair is trustworthy, but there are areas where she falls short. In that regard, being with Father is the best option.
“Naofumi-sama. With that said, please take care of us.”
The sister’s friend bowed her head. Hmm, persuasion complete. The sister’s friend is proving to be quite useful.
“Yeah. I’m counting on you.”
At that moment, the egg I was holding and the one Father had begun to stir.
This is it!
“Ah…”
Father took out the egg, and I placed mine in a suitable spot.
“Pii!”
One after another, energetic Filolial chicks emerged from the eggs. Ren and Itsuki also peered in with curiosity.
“So, these are Filolial chicks.”
“They look like regular chicks at first.”
Sakura-chan energetically climbed onto the hand that Father extended. How adorable. Well, Filolials are equally adorable at any stage.
